as_told.title: University parapsychology programs and the constricted present

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that several top American universities once ran research programmes in parapsychology, the study of claimed mind abilities such as telepathy and sensing the future. He names a research centre linked to Duke University, a lab at Princeton, and work at a research institute tied to Stanford. In a later episode he adds that these programmes came out saying the present moment seems to be 'constricted', which he raises as a hint that the mind may reach beyond the here and now.
